pyramiding_rule: Strictly prohibit adding to losing positions; only scale into winning positions when price crosses at least 1.5 ATR in favor and volatility contracts.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require confirmation via a multi-timeframe structural volume imbalance break before opening any position, avoiding raw tick-level counter-trend entries.
profit_harvest_threshold: Scale out 50% of volume at +$10.00, trailing the remainder with a volatility-adjusted ATR stop to capture asymmetric runs up to +$30.00.
